hosea.7.p1.b1.text: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.

hosea.7.p1.b2.text: The princes are inflamed with wine on the day of our king; so he joins hands with those who mock him.

hosea.7.p1.b3.text: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers. All their kings fall; not one of them calls upon Me.

hosea.7.p1.b4.text: Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is an unturned cake.

hosea.7.p1.b5.text: So Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove— calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria.

hosea.7.p1.b6.text: As they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like birds of the air. …

hosea.7.p1.b7.text: They turn, but not to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. …
